scene.language: You're the center mid. You need to receive the ball and find a good pass.[0] [1](mouse clicking) You have received the ball. The defender is cutting off the left and right striker, so you can't really pass to them. The right winger has a... is a... is at a bad angle, kind of behind you, and the left winger seems like the best passing option because it's forward and has space from their defender. [2](mouse clicking)[3][4] The left winger has received the ball. Now, you need to support them to give them a passing option. (mouse clicking)[5]
